title: The title that will be displayed in the header bar
current-item: Label for the currently selected OpenLP service item
no-live-item: Status shown when OpenLP has no live service item
start-first-item: Button that explicitly starts the first valid queued service item when no item is live
no-valid-service-items: Feedback shown when there is no valid queued service item to start
connecting: Connection status shown before an OpenLP API response
connected: Connection status shown when the OpenLP API is available
connection-unavailable: Connection status shown when the OpenLP API cannot be reached
previous-lyric: Button to move back through revealed lyric chunks or OpenLP slides
next-lyric: Button to reveal the next lyric chunk or advance OpenLP slides
previous-line: Button label when automatic line splitting is enabled
next-line: Button label when automatic line splitting is enabled
next-line-preview: Preview label for the next unrevealed lyric line/chunk
next-slide-preview: Preview label for the upcoming OpenLP slide or verse
previous-item: Button to move to the previous live service item
next-item: Button to move to the next live service item
theme-only: Button to put the OpenLP display in theme-only mode
blank: Button to blank the OpenLP display
show: Button to show the OpenLP display
auto-split-navigation-help: Explains that enabling automatic line splitting makes Next/Previous reveal lyric lines before advancing OpenLP slides; disabling it makes those buttons control OpenLP slides directly
display-history: Settings group containing display undo, redo, and hide controls
text-formatting-help: Explains that formatting options preserve selected formatting from OpenLP instead of applying formatting
api-authentication-required: Error shown when OpenLP rejects a command because API authentication is enabled
command-failed: Error shown when an OpenLP command request fails
display-next-1: First independently configured button for displaying the number of lines selected in its adjacent number spinner
display-next-2: Second independently configured button for displaying the number of lines selected in its adjacent number spinner
display-remaining: This button allows the user to display the rest of the lines on the current slide
undo-display: This button allows the user to go back to whatever was previously displayed
redo-display: After using the 'undo display' button, this button allows the user to display what follows
hide-display: This button hides or shows the lyrics overlay without changing the OpenLP live display
previous-slide: This button tells OpenLP to go to the previous slide
next-slide: This button tells OpenLP to go to the next slide
auto-update-text: Option to automatically update the text shown on the stage when OpenLP changes its displayed content
display-all-text: Option to always show all the lines on the slide being shown by OpenLP
auto-hide-on-blank: Option to automatically hide the stage when OpenLP goes to a blank-screen option (and show again when OpenLP does)
auto-resize-text: Option to change the text's font size automatically so that it fits in the window
auto-split-long-lines: Option to automatically split long lines based on maximum characters and minimum words
max-characters-per-line: When automatically splitting long lines, this option determines how many characters at most are allowed per line
min-words-per-line: When automatically splitting long lines, this option determines the minimum number of words per line
text-formatting: Label showing that the following options have to do with text formatting
text-formatting-all: Option to allow all HTML tags
text-formatting-superscript: Option to allow superscripted formatting. Parenthetically indicate that this applies to verse numbers
current-slide: Label for the text of the currently shown slide
button-size: Option to allow for different sized buttons
normal: Option to choose a normal button size
large: Option to choose a larger-than-normal button size
larger: Option to choose the largest available button size
font-size: Option to change the font size
crossfade-duration: Option to change the length (in milliseconds) of crossfades
fade-duration: Option to choose how long (in milliseconds) a fade-out or fade-in transition will take
vertical-anchor: Option to set the vertical anchor
top: Option to choose a top vertical anchor
bottom: Option to choose a bottom vertical anchor
center: Option to choose a center vertical anchor
vertical-offset: Option to choose the vertical offset
horizontal-anchor: Option to choose the horizontal anchor
left: Option to choose a left horizontal anchor
right: Option to choose a right horizontal anchor
horizontal-offset: Option to choose the horizontal offset
title-layout: Label for the title layout options
lyrics-layout: Label for the lyrics layout options
image-settings: Label for the image display settings
image-fit: Option to choose how image slides fit the OBS browser source
image-fit-contain: Preserve the full image and its aspect ratio, leaving unused space as needed
image-fit-cover: Fill the source while preserving aspect ratio, cropping the image as needed
image-fit-fill: Stretch the image to fill the source, potentially changing its aspect ratio
max-width: Option to choose the maximum width
display-control: Label for the display control section
slide-control: Label for the slide control section
title-visibility: Label for options that control when to display the title
title-visibility-song: Option to display title when song lyrics are live
title-visibility-scripture: Option to display title when Scripture is live
